data.narrative:
Alef Aeronautics is a Series A transportation company that has raised $30M+ to date. The broader transportation sector comp universe includes six private peers—notably Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, FleetZero, and REGENT Craft—though no public comparables are available. The narrower peer set of same-stage or adjacent-stage transportation companies proved insufficient (fewer than three datapoints) to support a reliable median multiple approach.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable valuation lever. Using total capital raised ($30M) as a proxy for current enterprise value and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier associated with Series A progression yields an implied valuation of $60M. This method assumes the company's current valuation approximates deployed capital and that transportation sector dynamics support standard venture step-up multiples at this stage.

The triangulated valuation range is $51M (low) to $69M (high), centered on a $60M median. This range reflects a single-method analysis and carries material uncertainty given the absence of stage-matched private comps and public market anchors in the transportation hardware space. Key variables include product development stage, path to revenue, and whether capital deployment to date has created equivalent proportional value. Material due diligence on technical feasibility and competitive positioning would be necessary before relying on this range for investment decision-making.
